notes: «وقال لنا أبو نعيم» names the first link; Ibn Umar, whose own action is reported, is the last link
«ورفعه عبد الرزاق أخبرنا عبيد الله» is a second transmitter for the same report, raised by Abd al-Razzaq, read as a variant group that stops at Ubayd Allah
«يعني يوم النحر» is an editor's gloss, left out
